list: Official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online. Names, descriptions, grades and PSN counts verified 2026-11-19 against PSNProfiles and Exophase; guides are this entry's own words and cite their sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. Work the roadmap in order — story, side characters, activities, collectibles, robberies — and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, since there is no mission replay. When the 54th trophy lands, this one follows at once.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. This is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed — it pops when the mission completes, so just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 ends (OutputLag; GTABase and PowerPyx via EGamers). Keep a manual save at the chapter start.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens most of the list's side content — start stranger mission chains as soon as they appear, since TechWiser reports their windows follow story progress (single source, via EGamers).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its missions in order. Nothing here needs grinding: chapter trophies pop when the last mission of the chapter ends, so keep pushing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Before moving on, take the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — it unlocks Maximum Withdrawal, robbing bank vaults, and it is easy to pass by (GTABase via EGamers).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep a manual save before it: there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back if you want to retry it or mop up anything tied to the ending (OutputLag). One of only two golds in the list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story-mission trophies pop when the mission ends, so there is nothing to prepare — just play the mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy: it unlocks when the heist mission ends, with no extra requirement beyond finishing it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops at the mission's end — a story trophy with no side requirement, so keep following the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks when the mission completes — no collectibles or extra steps involved.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. A story trophy that pops on mission completion; the airport itself matters for Catch Me If You Can later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends — play the story in order and it comes to you.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist — the hardest trophy in the list and the second gold. PowerPyx puts the thresholds at roughly 60% of true completion and says most progress comes from the other trophies, with the checklist finished after the story (EGamers). Note the checklist asks for more than the trophies in places: 300 stunts vs 250, 30 races vs 20, 70 challenges vs 50, 15 card sets vs 3, 8 bank vaults vs 5.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts (PSN tracks 0/250). Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, and flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind (GTABase and PowerPyx via EGamers). The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy if you are chasing the platinum.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once (PSN tracks 0/9). Sample one of every activity the game offers — races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation and stunts are among them — and the trophy pops on the ninth type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PSN tracks 0/42). Work through every challenge at the range until each shows gold; the 100% checklist asks for the same 42, so nothing here is wasted (EGamers).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location (PSN tracks 0/14). PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 locations, so win at least one race at each of the 14 spots (EGamers).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (PSN tracks 0/20). Any race type counts as long as each win is a different race; the 100% checklist wants 30, so keep racing past the trophy on the road to A Long Road (EGamers).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him; it was already earned by over 1% of players within hours of launch, the earliest non-story trophy by rarity (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play any one arcade game through to its end. Pick the shortest game you find and finish it; there is no score target in the description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's mission strand to its last mission — side-character strands end in a trophy, so follow each character's missions when they appear.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's strand through to its final mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand to its last mission — like the other character finales, it is a story trophy with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida (PSN tracks 0/8). Start each strand as soon as it unlocks — TechWiser reports their windows follow story progress, so do not leave them all to post-story (single source, via EGamers). One of the six silvers.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through to its final mission; the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission — the fifth and last of the named character finales.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (PSN tracks 0/18; GTABase counts 18 spots, while the 100% checklist says 15 — EGamers notes the two disagree, so visit every spot you find). THE missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, and there is no mission replay (OutputLag; GTABase and PowerPyx via EGamers). Do it in Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and meditate at every spot you pass.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal is unconfirmed at launch (EGamers) — follow Bret's strand and take the hunt it offers rather than guessing at a species; the trophy pops when that hunt is done.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets (PSN tracks 0/3). The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so the trophy is only the first milestone — keep collecting past it on the way to A Long Road (EGamers).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations (PSN tracks 0/100) — the same 100 the 100% checklist asks for, so this one and the checklist finish together (EGamers). Use the WAiNK app at every marked location you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges (PSN tracks 0/50). Challenges are the game's side objectives; the checklist wants 70, so the trophy lands on the way to 100% — just keep clearing them as you play (EGamers).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone — both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a hiding spot, and bank vault robberies often bring the wanted level (GTABase and PowerPyx via EGamers).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while still wanted — North Vice City jewelry stores sit close together, and if it does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth (EGamers).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles (PSN tracks 0/100). According to GTABase, scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK — no need to drive them — and scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient (EGamers).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus before you start, use an assault rifle and aim for gang members — cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count (GTABase via EGamers). A gang shootout is the natural place to try it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. GTABase's lead: steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away (EGamers). That is a single-source method, so treat it as the best current lead rather than confirmed — check for newer reports before grinding it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the description names the Rhino tank. GTABase: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it (EGamers). Expect heavy resistance getting the tank out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Open the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and clear out the safe without anyone spotting you (GTABase via EGamers). Go slow, stay out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape (PSN tracks 0/5). It needs the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open — expect 4 stars and have a fast bike ready for the escape (GTABase via EGamers). The checklist wants 8 vaults, so keep robbing past the trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives — a fast getaway vehicle helps.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida (PSN tracks 0/52). This means clearing the fog across all 52 areas — flying over the dark patches is reportedly the quickest method (GTABase via EGamers). A plane or helicopter tour of the map finishes it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang (PSN tracks 0/9) — one operation from each of the 9 gangs (GTABase via EGamers). Work through the gang operations list until every gang has been hit once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The steps are unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx marks this one not yet known (EGamers). The description points at a cocktail spot with a view on Ocean Beach, so try the beachfront bars there and check back as guides confirm the exact spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. GTABase thinks it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, but that is not confirmed (EGamers). Do not grind blind — wait for a confirmed method rather than smashing every showroom in the state.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The wording is unclear at launch (EGamers) — play a full game at that alley; a follow-through is bowling language for completing your throw, so finish your frames there and see if it pops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTABase's lead: max out Strength for both characters (single source, via EGamers). Train Strength for Jason and Lucia to the max and watch for the pop.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). GTABase links it to 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (single source, via EGamers), and PSN tracks 0/500. Keep making choices that move the profile and watch the counter climb — and check the Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage, since one profile outcome is permanent (EGamers).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. PowerPyx marks the method not yet known at launch (EGamers) — the name suggests succeeding on a retry, but no steps are confirmed, so do not chase it blind; watch for a confirmed report.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx marks it not yet known; GTABase links it to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, unconfirmed (EGamers). It reads like a random world event — keep playing, explore odd corners of the map, and wait for a confirmed trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Steps are unconfirmed at launch (EGamers) — the name describes knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. No confirmed method yet; do not grind it blind.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (PSN tracks 0/250000). Launder through fences — according to GTABase one fence pays the most — and the total grows during the 100% robberies (EGamers). Marked Bills come from robberies, so this finishes alongside the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (PSN tracks 0/100000). Buy gear, clothes and supplies across shops; the counter is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending plus a shopping spree finishes it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties (PSN tracks 0/8). Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total — the 4 story garages do not count (GTABase via EGamers). Save the cash and buy them in one sweep late in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (PSN tracks 0/10). Register ten different vehicles you own or find through the app — any ten count, so use the cars you already drive.

roadmap.title: Before you start
roadmap.text: Turn cheats OFF — GTABase and TechWiser report cheats disable trophies and saving, and only a clean save fixes it (EGamers). Make a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission: GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus (OutputLag). Turn on Spoiler-safe below if you want story names hidden.

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 and the finale
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1–4 in order, then the final mission (12 chapter/mission trophies + 1 gold). In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and may vanish after the chapter. From Chapter 2 both characters are playable and most side content opens.

roadmap.title: Side characters and strangers
roadmap.text: Finish the five named character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), Bret's hunt, and 8 stranger mission strands (silver). Start stranger chains as soon as they unlock — their windows are reported to follow story progress.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.text: Shooting Range golds (42), 250 stunts, 20 race wins, drone races at all 14 spots, fishing vs Cal, one arcade game, bowling, meditation at all 18 spots, 50 challenges, 9 activity types, Combat Focus x5, and the 500 Criminal Profile actions. Most of these overlap with the 100% checklist.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.text: 3 card sets (15 for 100%), WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles scanned, all 52 Leonida areas unfogged, plus the cryptic trophies (cocktail on Ocean Beach, showroom, bowling alley, the strange event) as guides confirm them.

roadmap.title: Robberies, money and the platinum
roadmap.text: 5 bank vaults (8 for 100%), armored truck, 3 shops in a row with your partner, one illegal operation per gang, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, 4-star escape with your partner — then finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road (gold) and Vice Got a Price! (platinum).

notes: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline — there are no online trophies (EGamers, KeenGamer). No difficulty trophies and no mission medals. Platinum estimate ~200 hours (PowerPyx/GTABase via EGamers). Five trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) plus Fair Game's animal unconfirmed — their guides say so plainly instead of guessing.
